items.name: liability-management-card
items.title: Liability management card
items.description: Forms and native economics of a distressed exchange offer and a liability management exercise, with Rust's own tender recommendation.
items.docs: Two forms. Exchange offer, the holder's view: hold-out PV, new instrument PV, consent fee, equity sweetener and offer structure, with the returned tender total, NPV pickup, breakeven recovery and tender_recommended, which is Rust's field and never compared here; the hurdle Rust applies shows beside it as supplied. Liability management exercise, the issuer's view: structure, notional, participation, EBITDA and a price input that Rust reads as a price, an extension fee or a transferred-asset fraction by structure, with the returned cost, par retired, discount capture, holder impact and, for a positive EBITDA, the leverage block. Amounts use one unit you choose, with no currency conversion; percentages are fractions. An empty amount is sent as NaN for Rust to reject and an empty EBITDA stays unset. Each analysis shows its own native error. Accepts defaultExchange, defaultLme, onExchangeSubmit, onLmeSubmit, exchange, lme, hurdle, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: use-liability-management
items.title: useLiabilityManagement
items.description: Runs the native exchange-offer and LME analyses and reads the tender hurdle through the WASM worker.
items.docs: useExchangeOffer calls models.credit.liabilityManagement.analyzeExchangeOffer, useLme calls analyzeLme and useTenderRecommendationHurdle calls tenderRecommendationHurdle, each one native call with its arguments in the binding's positions. Null means no request. Requires FinstackQueryProvider. A rejected input is the hook error.

items.name: option-calculator
items.title: Option calculator
items.description: Calculator of a European option under Black-Scholes, Black-76 or Bachelier: the price or implied volatility and the Greeks, as Rust returned them.
items.docs: Edits the terms of a European option under Black-Scholes (spot, strike, rate, dividend yield, expiry), Black-76 (forward, strike, discount factor, expiry) or Bachelier (forward, strike, expiry), with a volatility to price or a price to invert. Calculate passes the request to the caller (usually the useOptionCalculator request); typed text becomes numbers as entered and an empty field is sent as NaN for Rust to reject. The returned price or implied volatility and the Greeks at that volatility are shown as Rust returned them, with the conventions the facade documents: Black-76 prices are discounted, Bachelier prices undiscounted; Black-Scholes vega and rhos are per 1% move and theta per day, forward-Greek vega per unit of volatility. A price Rust cannot invert is the whole error; Greeks Rust rejects (at zero volatility under Black-Scholes) show their native error beside the price. Accepts defaultRequest, onSubmit, result, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: use-option-calculator
items.title: useOptionCalculator
items.description: Runs a native Black-Scholes, Black-76 or Bachelier price or implied volatility with its Greeks through the WASM worker.
items.docs: One closed-form price or implied-volatility solve (models.bsPrice, black76Price, bachelierPrice, bsImpliedVol, black76ImpliedVol, models.volatility.impliedVolBachelier) in the facade's positional order, then the model's Greeks at that volatility. Null means no request. Requires FinstackQueryProvider. A price or solve Rust rejects is the hook error; Greeks Rust rejects carry their native error beside the value.

items.name: monte-carlo-diagnostics
items.title: Monte Carlo diagnostics
items.description: Monte Carlo valuation details: path counts, flags, standard error, seed and time grid.
items.docs: Published MonteCarloValuationDetails only: native counts, flags, standard error, full-width bigint seed and time grid. Includes the native LSMC standard-error caveat.

items.name: use-fx-delta-samples
items.title: useFxDeltaSamples
items.description: Evaluates an FX delta surface at supplied coordinates through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native FX delta-surface evaluation with complete immutable quote/coordinate/forward keys. Null means no sampling request. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns annualized Black decimal volatilities or native errors.

items.name: use-fx-strike-surface
items.title: useFxStrikeSurface
items.description: Materializes an FX delta surface as a strike-space volatility surface through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native models.volatility.materializeFxDeltaSurface with complete immutable quote/spot/rate keys. Null means no request. Spot is domestic per unit of foreign; rates are continuously compounded decimals, never defaulted. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns the canonical stored-surface JSON or native errors.

items.name: use-cube-samples
items.title: useCubeSamples
items.description: Evaluates a SABR volatility cube at supplied coordinates through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Checked native cube evaluation with complete SABR/forward/interpolation/coordinate/convention query keys. Null disables sampling. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; no local model calculation or clamping.

items.name: use-cube-slice
items.title: useCubeSlice
items.description: Materializes a fixed-tenor or fixed-expiry slice of a SABR volatility cube at explicit strikes through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native models.volatility.materializeCubeTenorSlice/ExpirySlice and their Normal variants with complete immutable cube/axis/value/strike/convention keys. Null means no request. Strikes are absolute in the stored forwards' rate units; off-node values are Rust-interpolated. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; returns the canonical slice JSON or native errors.

items.name: use-cube-smile
items.title: useCubeSmile
items.description: Evaluates the SABR smile of one volatility-cube node, its static-arbitrage check and an optional repair through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Native VolCube paramsAt/forwardAt, SabrParameters.fromJson and SabrSmile generateSmile, validateNoArbitrage and repairArbitrage with complete immutable keys. The continuously compounded decimal rate is required and never defaulted; omitted repair passes run no repair. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; errors are unchanged.

items.name: use-check-surface
items.title: useCheckSurface
items.description: Checks a stored volatility surface for static arbitrage with host-supplied forwards through the WASM worker.
items.docs: core.VolSurface.fromJson of the canonical stored surface, then models.volatility.checkSurface with every check enabled (butterfly, calendar spread, local-vol density), the supplied forward prices (one to broadcast or one per expiry, in the surface strike units) and the tolerance only when supplied (Rust DEFAULT_ARBITRAGE_TOLERANCE otherwise); the handle is freed. Keyed on the complete surface, forwards and tolerance and the worker session; null means no request. Rust rejects normal-quoted, shifted-Black and tenor-axis surfaces and missing or mis-sized forwards with a validation error, returned unchanged. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.

items.name: fx-surface-chart
items.title: FX surface chart
items.description: FX volatility surface: raw quotes, natively evaluated Black volatilities and a Rust-materialized strike grid as heatmaps, tables and slices.
items.docs: Raw FX quotes and native evaluated Black volatility, sharing surface table/slices/selection/exports. Supply original coordinates with explicit quote/base forwards and an explicit color domain. Missing forwards show only raw quotes; no curve choice or local conversion occurs. The strike grid materializes the quotes natively (models.volatility.materializeFxDeltaSurface) from an editable spot (domestic per unit of foreign) and continuously compounded domestic and foreign decimal rates, seeded only from initialSpot, initialDomesticRate and initialForeignRate. Requires FinstackQueryProvider. Quote editing uses market-context-form and use-market-validator.

items.name: vol-cube-slice
items.title: Volatility cube slice
items.description: Rust-materialized fixed-tenor or fixed-expiry slice of a SABR volatility cube, plus one node's native SABR smile, arbitrage check and repair.
items.docs: Slices a canonical cube at explicit absolute strikes (initialStrikes, one editable field each, in the given order) through models.volatility.materializeCube{Tenor,Expiry}Slice[Normal], rendered by the shared surface view with an explicit color extent per convention. The node smile comes from SabrSmile at the selected expiry/tenor node: normal volatility when beta < 1e-4, Black otherwise, as the facade documents; the arbitrage check needs an explicit continuously compounded decimal rate (initialRate, never defaulted) and the repaired line appears only when repairIterations is supplied. Strike ordering and domain are validated natively. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.

items.name: surface-arbitrage-badge
items.title: Surface arbitrage badge
items.description: Badge and popover of a stored volatility surface native static-arbitrage report: passed, violations by type and severity, not checked, or forwards not supplied.
items.docs: Runs models.volatility.checkSurface (through useCheckSurface) on a canonical stored surface with host-supplied forwards (one to broadcast or one per expiry, in the surface strike units; never inferred) and an optional tolerance. The badge shows Passed, the violation count, Not checked (the native error, such as a normal-quoted, shifted-Black or tenor-axis surface Rust does not check) or Forwards not supplied (no request is made). The popover lists the returned counts by type and severity and every violation (type, severity, expiry, adjacent expiry, strike, magnitude in total variance, suggested fix, description) in the order Rust returned them. Requires FinstackQueryProvider.

items.name: vol-cube-explorer
items.title: Volatility cube explorer
items.description: Explores a volatility cube by strike and convention using natively evaluated samples, with an optional Rust-materialized slice and node smile.
items.docs: Checked native volatility cube exploration. Supply canonical cube state, initial absolute strike and explicit normal or Black/lognormal convention, plus color extents for both output units. Original SABR parameters, forwards and shifts remain separate from evaluated samples. Supplying slice (explicit initialStrikes, optional initialRate and repairIterations) adds vol-cube-slice. Requires FinstackQueryProvider; editing uses market-context-form and native validation.

items.name: transition-matrix-heatmap
items.title: Transition matrix heatmap
items.description: Display of a native rating transition matrix, its regularized generator and projected cumulative default probabilities, as heatmaps and a term-structure figure or as tables.
items.docs: Display-only view of the results returned by useMigrationMatrix (models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled) and useMigrationProjection (GeneratorMatrix.fromTransitionMatrix, then models.credit.migration.project per horizon). Labels and the default state come from the matrix's RatingScale. The transition and generator matrices are heatmaps (origin by destination, scale order); probabilities use the colour domain [0, 1] and the generator the extent of its intensities, centred on zero when the negative diagonal and positive off-diagonals straddle it. The generator's round-trip error and L1 regularization are stamped beside it; cumulative default probabilities are drawn per origin state against the requested horizons. A view control switches every section to tables. A projection error (for example a round-trip tolerance Rust rejects) is shown inline while the matrix stays visible. Values are decimals as Rust returned them; nothing is computed. Accepts matrix, loading, error, projection, projectionLoading, projectionError, initialView, formatValue and density props; no worker or query provider required.

items.name: merton-calculator
items.title: Merton calculator
items.description: Calculator of a native models.credit.MertonModel report: the generated MertonModel form or a KMV equity calibration, horizons and CDS terms, then the returned term structure, spreads, implied equity and master-scale grades.
items.docs: Edits a Merton structural-credit request: horizons, CDS maturity and recovery, and the model either with the schema form over the generated MertonModel contract (native validation through the caller's validate callback, usually useMertonModelValidator) or as a KMV equity calibration (equity value and volatility, short- and long-term debt, rate, payout, calibration maturity). Calculate passes the request to the caller (usually the useMertonReport request). The returned report is shown as Rust returned it: CDS par spread and implied equity value and volatility tiles, a term-structure table (default probability, distance to default, implied and debt spreads, master-scale grade and central PD per horizon) and the canonical model parameters with the KMV default point of an equity calibration. A measure Rust rejects for the model (such as the debt spread of a first-passage barrier) shows its native error beside the rest. Values are decimals with no units inferred. Accepts defaultRequest, validate, onSubmit, report, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: credit-scorecard
items.title: Credit scorecard
items.description: Scorecard of a native models.credit.scoring model: the generated input-ratio form of Altman Z, Z', Z'' and EM, Ohlson O or Zmijewski, then the returned score, zone, implied PD and default master-scale grade.
items.docs: Edits the input ratios of one accounting-based credit model (Altman Z-Score, Z'-Score, Z''-Score or EM-Score, Ohlson O-Score, Zmijewski probit). The fields, their order and their help text come from the generated input contract of the selected model (altman_z_score_input, altman_z_prime_input, altman_z_double_prime_input for both Z'' and EM, ohlson_o_score_input, zmijewski_input); each model keeps its own entries when another is selected. Score passes the model and the ratios to the caller (usually the useCreditScore request); typed text becomes numbers as entered and an empty field is sent as NaN for Rust to reject. The returned score, zone and implied PD are shown as Rust returned them, with the default PD master scale's grade and central PD of the implied PD, or Rust's error when the model returns no implied PD (the Altman models). Nothing is computed or classified here. Accepts defaultModel, defaultInputs, onSubmit, score, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: portfolio-risk-report
items.title: Portfolio risk report
items.description: Report of native models.factor.risk results: portfolio VaR and ES, component-VaR bars, VaR and ES contributions, the risk budget, the tail stress attribution and a book's factor contributions as returned.
items.docs: Presents the report the worker positionRisk returns (usually through usePositionRisk): portfolio VaR, ES, confidence, method, position count and the Euler residual stamp (none for a historical decomposition); bars of each returned component VaR; the VaR contributions (component, relative, marginal and incremental VaR) and ES contributions tables; the risk budget (has_breach, total_overbudget and per-position actual and target component VaR, utilization and excess) when one was requested; and, for a historical source, the tail stress attribution (VaR threshold, tail scenario count, per-position tail contributions in Rust's largest-driver-first order and the tail scenarios worst first). A budget or stress attribution Rust rejects shows its native error beside the rest. Values are as returned: losses negative, in the units of the supplied weights or P&L, shares as fractions; nothing is summed, flagged or re-sorted. With factors (usually from useFactorRisk) it adds a Factor contributions section: total and residual risk under the returned measure, risk by factor (absolute, relative and marginal), risk by position and factor, any residual risk by position, and the portfolio.computeFactorSensitivities matrix it decomposed in the book's base currency; the factor chain's native error shows in that section. Either part renders without the other. Accepts report, factors, factorsError, loading, error, formatValue and density props.

items.name: use-migration-matrix
items.title: useMigrationMatrix
items.description: Builds a native rating transition matrix from labelled rows through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled over the supplied labels (rows and columns share one order; the last label is the absorbing default state), rows and horizon in years, then toRows, defaultProbabilities, horizon and the labels and default state of the matrix's RatingScale. Every handle is freed, including the scale the getter returns. Rows that do not sum to one, a non-absorbing default row or a non-positive horizon return the native validation error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-migration-projection
items.title: useMigrationProjection
items.description: Estimates a native generator from a labelled transition matrix and projects default probabilities to explicit horizons through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.migration.TransitionMatrix.fromLabeled, GeneratorMatrix.fromTransitionMatrix (an omitted roundTripTol stays unset so Rust applies its default) and models.credit.migration.project once per requested horizon. Returns the generator's rows, roundTripError and regularizationL1, and each projected matrix's horizon and default probabilities in request order. Every handle is freed. A round trip beyond the tolerance or an invalid horizon returns the native error unchanged. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-merton-report
items.title: useMertonReport
items.description: Runs native models.credit.mertonReport, graded on the default PD master scale, through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.credit.mertonReport: one native call taking a MertonReportRequest (canonical MertonModel JSON, or an equity source Rust calibrates to the KMV default point) and returning the full MertonReport, graded on the default PD master scale. A measure Rust rejects for the model carries its message beside the rest; a rejected request is the hook error.

items.name: use-merton-model-validator
items.title: useMertonModelValidator
items.description: Validates MertonModel JSON natively through the WASM worker and returns its canonical form.
items.docs: models.credit.MertonModel.fromJson then toJson; the handle is freed. Superseded revisions reject. Connect it to the merton-calculator validate prop. Requires the shared Finstack provider.

items.name: use-credit-score
items.title: useCreditScore
items.description: Scores a firm with a native models.credit.scoring model graded on the default PD master scale through the WASM worker.
items.docs: Calls one models.credit.scoring function (altmanZScore, altmanZPrime, altmanZDoublePrime, altmanEmScore, ohlsonOScore or zmijewskiScore) with the request's named ratios in the facade's positional order, then models.credit.pd.MasterScale.defaultCalibration().mapScore of the result; a result Rust cannot grade (no implied PD) keeps its native error beside the score. The scale handle is freed. Keyed on the complete request (non-finite ratios stay distinct) and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-position-risk
items.title: usePositionRisk
items.description: Decomposes position VaR and ES with native models.factor.risk, evaluates a risk budget and attributes tail stress through the WASM worker.
items.docs: models.factor.risk.parametricVarDecomposition(positionIds, weights, covariance, confidence, computeIncremental) or historicalVarDecomposition(positionIds, pnls, confidence); then, when a budget is requested, evaluateRiskBudgetFromDecomposition over the decomposition and the targets; and, for a historical source, buildStressAttribution of the same P&L. Omitted confidence, incremental flag and utilization threshold are left to Rust. The budget and stress attribution keep their own native errors beside the decomposition. Keyed on the complete request (non-finite values stay distinct) and worker session; native errors are returned unchanged. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.

items.name: use-factor-risk
items.title: useFactorRisk
items.description: Computes a host-supplied book's native factor sensitivities and decomposes them under a factor covariance through the WASM worker.
items.docs: portfolio.computeFactorSensitivities(portfolio, factorsJson, market, asOf, bumpConfigJson) over the worker's cached Portfolio and MarketContext handles, then models.factor.risk.decomposeFactors of the returned matrix's JSON, the covariance JSON and the optional risk-measure JSON. Omitted bump config and risk measure are left to Rust (1 bp / 1 % per factor type; variance). Returns { sensitivities, decomposition } as Rust returned them, or the first native error. Keyed on the complete request and worker session. Requires the shared Finstack/Query provider.
